newsitem.title: USA: PureTec to cut 10 percent of staff at Burlington plant. [CORRECTED 15:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: PureTec to cut 10 percent of staff at Burlington plant. [CORRECTED 15:40 GMT]

text.p: PureTec Corp., a producer of plastics, said Friday it is cutting about 10 percent of its staff in its Burlington, N.J. operation, a move it said will reduce annual expenses by $750,000.
The company was not immediately able to provide information on how many jobs this effects.
PureTec said the cuts are part of an effort to improve operations and profitability at the Burlington speciality vinyl resins division.
The company said the cuts include both management and union employees.
PureTec employs about 2,000 people and operates 22 (corrects figure from 220) manufacturing plants.
